units.source_text: 山门一片漆黑，寂然无声。

en.t: The temple gate was completely dark and utterly silent.

units.source_text: 早晨鸣钟时就熄灭的便门上的灯还在微微发亮。

en.t: The light above the side gate, which should have been put out when the morning bell rang, was still faintly glowing.
I pushed open the side gate.

units.source_text: 门内侧吊着静航的古老而生锈的铁锁发出了响声，门打开了。

en.t: The old, rusted iron lock belonging to Seiko, hanging on the inside of the gate, made a sound, and the gate opened.
